1
Login with facility code, then select your role
Your role determines which module cards you see by default
2
Open today's card for your department
Read the micro-task - it tells you exactly what to assess today
3
Score each checkpoint - Full / Half / Zero
Tap i for guidance - SI, RR, OB, CI methods explained for each checkpoint
4
Click Mark Done when all checkpoints scored
Unscored checkpoints auto-score as Full - review before marking
5
MO clicks Verify to confirm scores
Only MO (or designated verifiers) can verify. Verified cards sync to Firebase.
6
Close gaps before Grand Finale
Zero and half scores appear in Gap Closure - re-attempt and get MO re-verification
2
Full - 2 points
Fully available, correctly practiced, properly documented. No gaps.
1
Half - 1 point
Partially available or practiced. Gaps in implementation or documentation.
0
Zero - 0 points
Not available, not practiced, or no evidence found. Immediate action required.
70%
NQAS Threshold
70% overall - minimum 50% per Area of Concern - aim for 80% to be safe
